launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Aidan and Yevgeniy, Founders of Rezora IO

**TL;DR: Rezora is the first AI voice platform that gives HVAC, plumbing, roofing and other home service companies self improving AI receptionists with setup and launch taking only 10 minutes. They answer the customer's questions, qualify the job, and book it on your calendar.** 

We went live in August, and today 40+ businesses use Rezora, including roofing, HVAC and plumbing companies. We’ve grown 20% week over week since launch, with $23K MRR as of November 17.

**Try it yourself:** go to [rezora.io](http://rezora.io) and hit **Talk to Rezora**.\
\
<https://youtu.be/EInNja6hQVM>

**The problem**

In home services,  the phone is the lifeline of the business. But the owner is on a roof or under a sink when it rings, the office is on another call, and a shop that's open 8 to 6 on weekdays is closed for 118 of the week's 168 hours.

When a AC dies on a Sunday night, the homeowner doesn't leave a voicemail. They call the next name on Google, and whoever picks up first usually gets the job.

These companies already pay to make the phone ring with ads, lead sites and referrals. But 27% of their calls go unanswered.

\- **A receptionist** costs about $40,000 a year and goes home at 6.

\- **An answering service** takes a message, and someone calls back hours later.

\- **Most “AI voice” platforms are simply agencies…** setup time takes weeks, costs thousands, and isn’t trained for specific verticals.

**What Rezora does**

Self improving AI voice agents built for home service companies that you can launch in 10 minutes.

**1. An AI receptionist that answers every call, 24/7**. It answers questions from your own services, prices and policies, and books the job while the customer is still on the line. It never guesses: anything you haven't told it becomes a message or a transferred call. Emergencies like a burst pipe, a roof leak or no heat go straight to you instead of getting booked for next week.

**2. Live in minutes, no developer needed.** Paste your website, answer a few questions, and you’re all done. We train Rezora on real calls from these businesses, so it's built for the conversations that actually happen on a contractor's phone. Pricing is month to month: $589, everything included. 

Our asks

\- **Own an HVAC, roofing, or any other home service company?** Call Rezora at [rezora.io](http://rezora.io) then book a demo (<https://cal.com/team/rezoraio/rezora-io-video-call>) and we'll set it up with you. Or sign up on the site and go live on your own.

\- **Run or invest in a group of home service companies?** We'd love to talk about covering every location.

\- **Know an owner whose phone rings while they're on a job?** An intro means a lot.

Reach us anytime at [**founders@rezora.io**](mailto:aidan@rezora.io)

Thanks for reading!

Aidan and Yevgeniy
